# v1.0.13 — archival metadata aligned with the final submitted title

This release aligns the archived bibliographic metadata with the title of the
final submitted manuscript. No analysis artefact changes.

## What changed

- `.zenodo.json`: title, `version` (1.0.13) and a new change-log paragraph.
- `CITATION.cff`: title and `version` (1.0.13); the `doi` field keeps the concept
  DOI `10.5281/zenodo.23677282`, which always resolves to the latest version.
- `README.md`: header title and a new "Version 1.0.13" section. Earlier version
  notes are kept as historical records.

## What did not change

- No script, estimate, exhibit, figure or `run_all.sh` step.
- No CHARLS microdata; the repository guard `tools/check_no_microdata.py` was run
  on every changed file before the commit.

Zenodo's GitHub integration archives this release under the existing concept DOI
`10.5281/zenodo.23677282`; the version DOI is allocated when the release is published.
